value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver: partly sunny, high around 65 (other forecasts run 64 to 67). Winds north-northeast at 6 to 10 mph, gusting to 17 in the afternoon. Rain may move in after 3 pm, about a 30% chance, rising to around 35% by 11 PM. Overnight lows in the 30s to low 40s, with rain at times.
